english.note: Use 近 as the all-purpose choice for physical closeness, and in established expressions such as 近義詞 for approximate lexical similarity.

exampleSentences.english: This convenience store is very near my home.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢間便利店好近我屋企。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 bin6 lei6 dim3 hou2 gan6 ngo5 uk1 kei2

english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for something adjacent or close by.
Use 近 as the all-purpose adjective for small physical or time distance.

exampleSentences.english: This shop is close to the MTR station.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 lei4 dei6 tit3 zaam6 hou2 gan6

english.note: Use this for the very-close or adjacent sense, including something in the immediate vicinity.

exampleSentences.english: The convenience store is in the immediate vicinity of my home.
exampleSentences.traditional: 間便利店離我屋企好近。
exampleSentences.jyutping: gaan1 bin6 lei6 dim3 lei4 ngo5 uk1 kei2 hou2 gan6
